propositions: Mode inherits str, causing functools.total_ordering to fail overriding inherited string comparison methods, resulting in lexical instead of rank-based ordering
Mode.BOOTSTRAP_THROTTLE > Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK incorrectly evaluates to false due to string-based comparison, causing check_phase_gate to fail blocking higher modes
Rich comparison operators (__gt__, __le__, __ge__) must be explicitly implemented to use the _ORDERED rank contract instead of inherited string comparison
The five-mode rank order reconcile-check < dry-run < bootstrap-strict < bootstrap-throttle < live must be enforced across all comparison operators
